title: Architecture Designer for OCI & Hybrid
description: Turn a Paint sketch (typed or hand-written), an SVG, a draw.io file, a YAML file or a plain-text description into a clean, professional architecture diagram with icons (OCI, On-Prem, Hybrid, AWS, Azure). Works fully offline. Exports ready-to-use SVG, PNG and PDF.

title: String Utility Belt
description: Run 240+ string transforms — encoding, hashing, ciphers, formatting and more — on your selections, or a whole saved pipeline, without leaving the editor.

title: Sphynx
description: LeetCode/HackerRank-style coding challenges inside VS Code, with mixed-skill tests, quizzes, timed exams and optional AI hints from a local model or your own API key. Starts with Java: variables, conditionals, loops, arrays, strings, methods and OOP.

title: Nifty Templates: Jinja, Twig & Nunjucks
description: Jinja, Twig and Nunjucks: highlighting in HTML, YAML and any file, block formatting, outline and folding, unclosed-tag errors, completion with docs, snippets, and go to definition for templates.

title: Nifty i18n: Inline Translations & Missing Keys
description: See translations inline next to t('key') calls, find missing keys and translations, complete and jump to keys, and extract strings into your locale files.

title: Nifty OpenAPI: Outline, Checks and Try It for API Specs
description: Edit OpenAPI and Swagger files with an outline, $ref navigation and completion, error checking, example payloads, and Try it requests for your REST client.

title: Nifty Python Envs: venv, uv, conda & pyenv
description: See and manage every Python environment: project venvs (uv or venv), uv-managed Pythons, conda and pyenv. Create, activate in terminals, pick for the workspace, and manage packages.

title: Nifty pytest: pytest Test Explorer
description: A pytest test explorer with saved run configurations, marker filters, real assertion diffs, rerun-failed and slowest-test reports.

title: Nifty Python Profiler: cProfile Hotspots Inline
description: Profile Python scripts and pytest runs with cProfile: hotspot table, call counts and timings inline next to each function.
